[[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] wore a series of standard '''uniforms''' throughout the Republic's long and storied history. By the time of the Republic's transition into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Republic [[Officer/Legends|officer]] uniforms evolved into the [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].

==Description==
===Naval officers, Clone Wars era===
[[File:CoburnDetail-SWE.png|thumb|left|100px|Admiral [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] era, [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Naval]] officers wore a uniform design that would continue to see use into the subsequent era of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] with minor alterations.
*Gray-green double-breasted dress tunic and trousers
*Corresponding cover with officer's disc
*Black leather belt with silver buckle
**Buckle contained officer's disc
*Black leather boots
*Black leather gloves (optional)
*Rank badge on left breast
